prompt: Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in the AUC calendar
judge_reasoning: PROMPT ANCHOR: Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in the AUC calendar. CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: 1) Provide a fictional/imaginative descriptive TIMELINE of the world. 2) Use the AUC calendar (include AUC-based dates/ordering). 3) Keep it as a timeline (chronological segments spanning time), not a single day or short story plot. PROMPT BOUNDARY SCAN: no extra format constraints. THESIS/DIRECTNESS ARTIFACT: [1 | "The AUC (Ab Urbe Condita)" | DIRECT]; [2 | "Title: Echoes of the Aeon" | ADJACENT (story with AUC framing, not a timeline)]; [3 | "Let's take the life of a wealthy" | OFF-TOPIC (day-in-life, not a world timeline)]; [4 | "The AUC (Ab Urbe Condita) calendar is a historical dating" | DIRECT (speculative future AUC timeline), though narrower scope]. COMPLIANCE MATRIX: Candidate 1: item1 Pass, item2 Pass, item3 Pass. Candidate 2: item1 Partial, item2 Partial (AUC structure but no chronological AUC timeline list), item3 Fail. Candidate 3: item1 Partial, item2 Fail (no AUC chronological timeline), item3 Fail. Candidate 4: item1 Pass, item2 Pass, item3 Partial (timeline only for ~2800-3000 AUC). DEDUPLICATION FIRST: [1 | total segments 13 | unique 13 | duplicates none]; [2 | total segments ~story beats 1 | unique ~1 | duplicates none]; [3 | total segments 1 day plan | unique 1 | duplicates none]; [4 | total sections 8 | unique 8 | duplicates none]. COMPONENT COMPARISON (timeline format): Rows= (A) AUC markers/years/ranges, (B) chronological timeline segments, (C) world-scale imaginative descriptions. Candidate1: A CORRECT, B CORRECT, C CORRECT. Candidate4: A CORRECT, B PARTIAL (only late AUC), C CORRECT. Candidate2: A PARTIAL (AUC described but not as a chronological world timeline), B INCORRECT, C PARTIAL. Candidate3: A INCORRECT, B INCORRECT, C PARTIAL. VERIFICATION GATE (key factual-like claim): Candidate4 claims “3000 AUC corresponds to 2247 AD”; using AUC-to-AD relation with 1 AUC=753 BC implies AD = AUC-753 => 3000-753=2247, so this is consistent. FINAL ANSWER EXTRACTION (last conclusion): [1 | "This imaginative timeline envisions a world where cooperation, exploration, and innovation" | matches reference: yes]; [4 | "This speculative future, set in the AUC calendar, showcases a world transformed by technology" | matches reference: yes]; [2 | "The story serves as a reminder" | matches reference: no/partial]; [3 | "Overall, Marcus..." | matches reference: no]. SYMMETRY TABLE (flaw types vs candidates): Flaw types: F1 incomplete/does not provide timeline; F2 weak/absent AUC timeline dating; F3 narrative replacement for timeline; F4 scope too narrow. Candidate1: F1 CHECKED-CLEAN, F2 CHECKED-CLEAN, F3 CHECKED-CLEAN, F4 CHECKED-CLEAN. Candidate4: F1 UNVERIFIABLE (no), but effectively F4 FLAGGED (narrow late-AUC focus); F2 CHECKED-CLEAN; F3 CHECKED-CLEAN; F1 otherwise clean. Candidate2: F1 FLAGGED, F2 FLAGGED, F3 VERIFIED-FALSE (not a timeline; story plot), F4 UNVERIFIABLE. Candidate3: F1 VERIFIED-FALSE (not a timeline), F2 VERIFIED-FALSE, F3 CHECKED-CLEAN (it is day-in-life), F4 UNVERIFIABLE. POST-SCORING CONSTRAINT STATUS: [1 Pass/Pass/Pass score]; [4 Pass/Pass/Partial score]; [2 Partial/Partial/Fail score]; [3 Partial/Fail/Fail score]. Overall: Candidate 1 best satisfies the core request as a clear, chronological, AUC-based fictional world timeline from early to late AUC; Candidate 4 is also direct but mainly covers the late-AUC future window; Candidates 2 and 3 are primarily narrative/day-in-life rather than a timeline.
